title: FBI Photo B13
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The PDF page contains only an image with no extractable text — all facts come from the CSV metadata description, not from body text in the document itself.
The image was redacted before submission, meaning potentially identifying sensor data or HUD information has been removed.
No mission report accompanied the image, so there is no operational context, flight data, or observer narrative available.
The date shown in the image is confirmed to be incorrect, making temporal analysis unreliable.
Single-source submission with no corroborating sensor data or witness accounts.
The narrative description explicitly states it should not be interpreted as reflecting any analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination.

verifiable_claims.claim: The FBI submitted this UAP image to AARO
